items.headline: NFL trade deadline grades: Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys, J.J. McCarthy to Giants
items.description: Can Joey Porter Jr. clean up the Cowboys' defense? Will J.J. McCarthy improve the Giants' QB situation? We're grading NFL trades ahead of November's deadline.

items.headline: Sources: Steelers to trade Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys
items.description: The Steelers have agreed to trade cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-rounder, sources confirmed to ESPN on Wednesday night.

items.headline: Steelers rule Joey Porter out again; Jalen Ramsey questionable
items.description: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter will miss his fourth straight game as he has officially been declared out for Thursday night's game against the Browns.
